items: Reputation management gets much harder as you add locations, because reviews pile up across many sites, every one needs a reply, and you lose sight of what guests really think.
Choose software that centralizes reviews from Google, Yelp, Facebook and delivery apps in one inbox, monitors mentions elsewhere, and helps you reply quickly with AI-assisted responses.
Measure sentiment by location, topic and time, then turn that feedback into operational action, so you fix issues before they spread across your stores.
Momos unifies reviews from every platform and location, replies to each guest in your brand voice through its AI agent Alfie, and sends surveys that help you collect more reviews.
